_note: Questions offered by the console's New investigation page. Engagement content: edit per customer. Symptom-only: never put a planted cause, segment or date here (this repo is readable by the agent).

presets.title: Decline-rate investigation
presets.description: The canonical symptom-only question used for every full investigation (E8, K1).
presets.question: Payments operations reports that card authorization decline rates rose for a period during the data's date range. Determine whether there was a real increase in declines in payment_transactions, when it started and ended, which transactions were affected, and what caused it. Rule out alternative explanations.

presets.title: Smoke test
presets.description: A quick end-to-end check of the bridge, one worker and the warehouse (scripts/mcp_smoke.py).
presets.question: Smoke test: how many rows are in payment_transactions, and how many are declined (approved = false)? Use one subagent to count the declines.

presets.title: Row-count check
presets.description: The minimal one-worker run used by the restart and cancel tests (scripts/kill_test.py).
presets.question: Kill test: how many rows are in payment_transactions? Use one subagent to count them.
